$comment: HyperFrames Project — the single source of truth for Track B (PRD §20). Studio, Product Editor, Agent, and Player all read/write ONE project shaped like this. The in-space editor mirror of the ownership map lives in lib/trackB/schema.ts and MUST stay in sync with this file (this file is canonical).

field_ownership.$comment: Who may write each field. PLANNER = creative structure (Opus). BUILDER = implementation (Sonnet). USER = customer-editable. SYSTEM = runtime/version/render metadata. Customer mutations touching non-USER fields are rejected, never silently applied.

$comment_states: Track B product scenes default to EDITABLE. Track A footage embedded in a project is always BAKED. The UI must explain WHY a control is unavailable for non-EDITABLE scenes.

project_shape.schema_version: string — this file's schema_version at creation
project_shape.version: integer — bumped on EVERY successful mutation, never reused
project_shape.last_render_version: integer|null — project.version captured by the most recent successful render
project_shape.track: 'product' (Track B) — the explicit track selection, persisted at creation, never auto-routed
project_shape.status: draft | planned | building | validated | rendered | qa_passed | delivered | error
project_shape.title: string (USER)

scenes.intent: PLANNER — what this scene must communicate
scenes.motion: PLANNER — motion strategy (ease families, direction, ambient treatment)
scenes.headline: USER text — always a coded overlay, never baked into visuals
scenes.caption: USER text

voice.plan: PLANNER voice_plan: { tone, pace, energy, accent, gender, age_range, emotional_arc, lines: [{scene_id, text}] }
voice.voice_id: SYSTEM — ONE voice identity per film; line regeneration MUST reuse this id

music.track: ledger id of a frozen audio asset (USER)

renders.$comment: Every render records the exact versions it was produced from (PRD §20.2).
renders.sha256: content hash of the output file

project_shape.checklist: PLANNER — the §24 Definition-of-Done checklist instantiated for this film
